law_text: The driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision, and upon entering the roadway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on said roadway.

required_context: Applicable jurisdiction and driver and vehicle scope.
Construct and document the driveway, intervening sidewalk area, roadway boundary and connected road-entry route with vehicle clearance.
Do not infer a crosswalk or controlled-access entrance from the driveway.
Document pedestrian motion and all approaching roadway vehicles, including direction, speed, proximity and precedence, without assigning collision-risk or right-of-way judgment thresholds.
Establish municipal applicability, driver control, vehicle scope and unresolved applicability of supplied definitions.
Observe approach, complete cessation before the sidewalk, sidewalk crossing and roadway entry without imposing a statutory stop duration or immediately-prior cutoff.
Pedestrian route and all approaching roadway vehicles, their direction, speed and proximity.
Private driveway geometry, sidewalk area and connected road-entry route with vehicle clearance.
Residence-district evidence, including residential frontage and non-business-district status.
Supply residence-district frontage evidence, non-business-district context, private driveway ownership and permitted-use facts.
The driveway is not assumed to be a crosswalk or controlled-access entrance; device variants are not used.
